facts.business: Captain Technocast Limited is a listed public company and a holding company of Captain Castech Limited, X2 Valves Private Limited, and Vartis Engineering Private Limited (until June 2026).
key_risks: economic development within India and the countries within which the Company conducts business
facts.related_party_note: All related party transactions were on an arm's length basis and in the ordinary course of business. There were materially significant Related Party Transactions made by the Company during the year which were as per shareholders' approval under the SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2018.
